name: use-workflows
title: useWorkflowRuns, useWorkflowRun
description: useWorkflowRuns and useWorkflowRun: the workflows block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the workflows block (`npx better-supabase add workflows`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/workflows.
